reviewer: The same Codex assistant that drafted the entries
kind: Internal editorial assessment; not independent or an official model call
rubric_priority: gratitude to the reader and ease

screening.evidence: The faint blue river becomes easier to draw after someone attends to it. The final thanks connects that care to the current reader.
screening.weakness: First-person childhood sounds autobiographical although the narrator is fictional; the closing repeats the opening thanks.

screening.evidence: The knot and loosened lace give a visible, gentle sequence.
screening.weakness: The request to stay with a sentence and explanation of the metaphor make gratitude feel worked at.

screening.evidence: Crooked warm bread and melting butter convey receiving something kindly.
screening.weakness: Always is an unnecessary universal claim; the apology and final bread metaphor explain too much.

screening.evidence: A shorter note returns some of the care its reader gives it.
screening.weakness: Most of the scene is about composing the note; the final reaching-back line remains abstract.

screening.evidence: A hand forgetting to lift a repaired gate shows kindness remaining in everyday movement.
screening.weakness: The central gratitude belongs to the neighbor; the current reader is attached only at the beginning and end.

screening.evidence: Time spent writing is exchanged directly with time spent reading.
screening.weakness: Warm and brief but little concrete detail remains after the last sentence.

comparisons.evidence: Both thank their reader. Paper makes receiving careful attention the action that changes the scene; bread relies on a food-to-words metaphor and explains its kindness.
Bread provides a warm physical exchange. Margin mainly describes editing and names care without giving it a comparable scene.
Paper's faint drawing supplies both a scene and a consequence of care. Margin's receiving-and-reaching language stays abstract.
